reason: The refined primitive cell and tedhadleyite-like Hg/I/O average framework are strongly supported by peak positions and the high profile correlation, and the model is chemically plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: no comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, the reported fixed-width-Gaussian fit still has an Rwp-like value of about 0.115, and the coordinates were inherited from a disordered centrosymmetric COD parent rather than independently refined. Most importantly, the trace instantiated six Br/Cl assignments whose Rwp-like values are nearly indistinguishable (0.115061-0.115247); the selected P1, Z=1 realization is only the marginally best idealized ordering, while centrosymmetric and translation-breaking ordered supercell realizations remain scientifically plausible and were not submitted as alternatives. Thus the data support the cell/Z and average framework much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, exact coordinates, and Br/Cl ordering, so another attempt is warranted.
